Title:
Amendments to
IAS 21 Lack of
Exchangeability
(Amendments to
IAS 21)
Effective date:
Annual
periods
beginning
on or after
1 January
2025
(Published
August
2023)
Key requirements:
An entity is impacted by the
amendments when it has a
transaction or an operation in
a foreign currency that is not
exchangeable into another
currency at a measurement date
for a specified purpose.
This amendment did not have a
material impact on the Group’s
financial statements.
